style: Blue document-inspection robot with separate head, rounded triangular body, short gripper arms and three mechanical feet
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original cute robot mascot logo for MO-Parse, a document parsing research project.
Primary request: design a new, distinctive little document-inspection robot with a clearly separate head, visible short neck, low rounded triangular body and three short mechanical feet. This is a character logo, with a warm understated personality, designed as a tangible matte 3D-printed collectible.
Character silhouette: a small smooth oval blue head about one third of the figure height, sitting on a visible narrow neck joint above a wider rounded triangular pebble-shaped torso. Torso tapers upward, broad at the base, decidedly not rectangular or box-shaped. Three short sturdy articulated support legs, with two feet in front and one visible side/rear stabilizer, form a cheerful little tripod stance. Two small jointed mechanical arms end in simple two-prong grippers. The grippers gently hold one off-white document diagonally against the lower front of the body. Paper has a folded corner and only three short grey bars.
Face: the face is directly on the continuous matte blue head shell, with TWO SMALL dark navy round inset camera eyes and a tiny shallow engraved smile. No screen or visor, no face panel, no eye highlights, no large eyes or glowing marks. Add a small asymmetrical sensor notch at one temple as a modest mechanical detail. Express curiosity with a slight head tilt, no exaggerated baby proportions.
Palette: medium dusty cobalt-blue head and torso, deeper navy joints and feet, off-white neck ring and gripper fingertips, one tiny restrained amber status light on the side. Blue dominant. Do not use mint green.
Material/style: photographed physical matte PLA figurine with subtle fine FDM layer lines, small fabrication seams, soft edges and modest bevels. Clear spare geometric character design, approachable, not glossy toy candy, not anime. Soft neutral studio light, readable volume and natural shading in the joints.
Composition: one entire robot, three-quarter front view showing its right side, centered on square transparent RGBA canvas, occupying about 78 percent with clean transparent margins. All feet and the document fully visible. A compact cohesive silhouette suitable for a project logo.
Avoid: existing fictional character designs, rectangular console body, face embedded in torso, black television face, game-controller buttons, long tube arms or legs, printer output slot, treads, headphones, huge lenses, antennas, scenery, floor, pedestal, cast shadow, scattered particles, text, lettering, wordmark, watermark. Do not include extra objects or variants. Genuine alpha transparency, not a checkerboard background.
purpose: AI-generated mascot illustration with matte 3D-printed surface appearance
